text:
sam: quick question for the group — as we wire up the new Rollout Builder UX, should the Console create a single API call that accepts per-variant quota/seed/schedule, or should we keep separate calls (createExperiment, addVariant, setRoutingRules)?
maria: my vote is single call for the UX. users expect 'one save' and predictable atomicity. but that complicates API validation + partial failure handling. :thinking_face:
jordan: +1 for single call. we can return a transaction id and an async reconciliation status. also need to surface per-variant quota check failures before saving.
liam: the internal API team here — single call is fine, but we need explicit "dry_run" validation endpoint so console can validate rules without committing. also need quota preflight to check remaining capacity across dedicated pools.
emma: UX note: if validation fails for one variant we should highlight the variant row inline and keep the rest intact (don't clear presaved inputs). users hate losing edits.
sam: agree re dry_run. propose shape: ``POST /v1/experiments `` payload contains experiment + variants[] + routing_rules[] + schedule + optional quotas. backend returns {operation_id, validation_errors: []} for dry_run=false or just validation_errors for dry_run=true.
maria: sounds good. one design question — should we allow boolean predicates in routing (e.g. "country IN (...)") and arbitrary JS-like expressions? that's a security/scope risk.
jordan: we should support a small predicate DSL: operators, attributes, regex, and a safe function whitelist. avoid freeform JS. keep it limited to what the evaluator can optimize into routing shards.
liam: op-team: also need to enforce per-tenant QPS caps if a variant tries to reserve too much traffic. Suggest we run quota checks against committed capacity and return soft warnings vs hard rejects depending on the customer plan.
emma: telemetry ask: console should attach a trace id to the create call so we can connect the UI action -> API -> worker reconciliation in the dashboard. That helps when rollout fails mid-ramp.
ops-bot: deploybot: new experiment API schema registered in staging. Run `./scripts/api-migrate --schema=rollout_builder_v2` to sync local.
sam: thanks. action items: (1) liam -> add dry_run endpoint + quota preflight (2) jordan -> define predicate DSL doc + examples (3) maria/emma -> console UX change to single-commit flow + inline error highlights (4) instrumentation: attach trace_id on calls. I'll draft API spec and share here.
maria: one last thought — fallback routing: if a variant is rejected during runtime (resource shortage), we need clear fallback policy in the API (fallback_variant_id or traffic_shed_strategy). include that in the payload.
jordan: good call. include "fallback": {type: "variant", id: "..."} or {type: "holdback"}.
liam: we'll require that for Dedicated customers as a hard field.
sam: ok wrapping up — I'll post a PR with a first pass spec by EOD. thanks all :pray:
